acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Game-authored SM3 MOV/ADD/SUB/MUL/MAD/DP3/DP4/MIN/MAX, temp registers, swizzles and lane masks emit supported VS/PS HLSL and compile to DXBC, not an unsupported-mode success.
Uninitialized temp lanes, constant references without binding, unsupported modifiers/opcodes fail closed to unchanged D3D9 Draw/Present/input and DX9Ex fallback.
